tools.name: book_free_check
tools.description: The free Fifty Asks check: we ask ChatGPT, Perplexity and Gemini the questions a customer would ask for your trade and town, fifty times in all, and record who each one names first. You get a short written report by email: who gets named, whether you do, and the page facts the named businesses share

tools.name: list_call_slots
tools.description: Open times for a free 15-minute phone call with Fifty Asks (Central Time).

tools.name: book_call
tools.description: Book a free 15-minute phone call at an open slot from list_call_slots. Status is confirmed only when the calendar accepts it.

tools.name: get_booking
tools.description: Current status of a booking by its id (FA-XXXXXXXX).

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send a message to the Fifty Asks team. Agents are welcome; a person reads it and replies by email.

tools.name: get_payment
tools.description: Status of a payment request Fifty Asks sent you or your human (ref FA-P-XXXXXXXX): what it is for, the amount, and whether it is paid. 'paid' only when the money is confirmed.

tools.name: start_payment
tools.description: Open the checkout page for a payment request (ref FA-P-XXXXXXXX). Returns checkout_url: open it for your human, or pay there with a payment method your human gave you. Nothing is charged until the payer completes that page.

tools.name: get_shop
tools.description: A local shop that takes visit requests through the Fifty Asks booking widget (its id is in the shop's booking link, fiftyasks.com/b/<id>): name, area, phone, services, and the fields a request needs.

tools.name: request_visit
tools.description: Send a shop on the Fifty Asks widget a visit request for your human. It is a request, not a booked appointment: status is 'requested' until the shop confirms a time ('confirmed') or declines.

tools.name: get_visit_request
tools.description: Current status of a shop visit request by its id (FS-XXXXXXXX).

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: book_free_check · Private data: book_free_check · Public sink: book_free_check, send_message, request_visit.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: book_free_check · Private data: book_free_check · Public sink: book_free_check, send_message, request_visit

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
